The crust is rough and dry, leading to moderate static and dynamic friction coefficients (0.5 and 0.45), though the presence of loose flour could slightly reduce grip in reality. Restitution is estimated to be very low (0.1) because bread is relatively soft and inelastic; it absorbs impacts rather than bouncing. For collision modeling in Isaac Sim, a convex hull or a low-resolution convex decomposition is suitable to capture its overall bulky, slightly irregular shape without wasting performance on the fine surface details of the crust.
